entities.name: Stephanie is attacked by Mrs. Ganush in the car
entities.description: Mrs. Ganush pulls Stephanie's head back by her hair, bracing her feet against the front seat to gain leverage, bending Stephanie's neck to the point of near snapping.

entities.name: Stephanie staples Mrs. Ganush's forehead
entities.description: Stephanie uses a stapler to strike Mrs. Ganush multiple times, driving staples into her forehead, including one that staples her eyelid shut.

entities.name: Stephanie accelerates the car and crashes into a concrete column
entities.description: Stephanie shifts the car into gear and hits the gas, causing it to accelerate and collide violently with a concrete column.

entities.name: Mrs. Ganush is thrown forward and hits the dashboard
entities.description: During the crash, Mrs. Ganush's body is flung over the front seat and slams into the dashboard with great force, causing her dentures to be ejected.

entities.name: Stephanie opens the passenger door and ejects Mrs. Ganush
entities.description: After regaining consciousness, Stephanie reaches across Mrs. Ganush, opens the passenger door, and uses her foot to shove Mrs. Ganush out of the car.

entities.name: Mrs. Ganush attempts to re-enter the car
entities.description: After being thrown to the ground, Mrs. Ganush quickly rises and tries to climb back into the car through the open passenger door.

entities.name: Stephanie reverses the car and knocks Mrs. Ganush down
entities.description: Stephanie shifts the car into reverse, causing the open passenger door to strike Mrs. Ganush and knock her back to the pavement, while the rear bumper hits a concrete column.

entities.name: Mrs. Ganush limps toward the car and attempts to attack again
entities.description: Mrs. Ganush crawls to her feet and begins moving toward the car, eventually running at it with a shriek, reaching for the passenger door.

entities.name: Stephanie locks the car door and blocks Mrs. Ganush's entry
entities.description: As Mrs. Ganush reaches for the open passenger door, Stephanie closes and locks it just in time, preventing Mrs. Ganush from entering despite her furious attempts.

document_metadata.title: 62、INT. GREAT ROOM - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Shaun San Dena collapses after exorcising the Lamia; despite CPR, she dies. Rham Jas pronounces her gone, reciting a prayer as Milos calls for an ambulance.

entities.name: Shaun San Dena invokes Lamia during a spiritual ritual
entities.description: Shaun San Dena calls upon the entity Lamia to enter their circle, initiating a supernatural manifestation within a ritual setting.

entities.name: Lamia's presence manifests through scratching sounds intensifying in the room
entities.description: A series of faint scratching noises on wood grow louder and more distorted, signaling the approaching presence of the demon Lamia.

entities.name: Wind suddenly whips through the sealed room causing papers to whirl
entities.description: An unnatural wind erupts indoors despite all windows being closed, creating chaos as papers fly and signaling supernatural activity.

entities.name: Shaun San Dena becomes possessed by Lamia
entities.description: Shaun San Dena's body is overtaken by the demon Lamia, marked by rolling eyes, a slumping head, and subsequent revival with unnatural energy.

entities.name: Possessed Shaun San Dena speaks in a demonic voice and unknown tongue
entities.description: The possessed individual rapidly moves their lips and emits garbled, incomprehensible speech in a strange, otherworldly language.

entities.name: Rham Jas questions the entity inhabiting Shaun San Dena
entities.description: Rham Jas formally addresses the possessing spirit, asking it to identify itself, prompting the revelation that it is Lamia.

entities.name: Milos uncovers a slaughtering blade upon Rham Jas's signal
entities.description: In response to a discreet nod from Rham Jas, Milos reveals a ritual blade, preparing for potential confrontation with the possessing entity.

entities.name: Lamia declares intent to claim Stephanie Brown's soul
entities.description: Through the possessed body of Shaun San Dena, Lamia announces the desire to feast upon Stephanie Brown's soul and describes her suffering in hellfire.

entities.name: Stephanie attempts to reveal Jim Jacks as responsible
entities.description: Stephanie interrupts the ritual to assert that her manager, Jim Jacks, is the one behind the events, before being silenced.

entities.name: Rham Jas pleads with Lamia to spare Stephanie Brown
entities.description: Rham Jas appeals to Lamia, attempting to dissuade the demon from claiming Stephanie's soul by suggesting she is unworthy of his attention.

entities.name: Lamia laughs and reaffirms intent to torment Stephanie in hell
entities.description: The demon expresses cruel delight at the prospect of inflicting pain on Stephanie, confirming the determination to claim her soul.

entities.name: Spiritual Exorcism And Summoning Ritual
entities.description: A structured ritual gathering conducted by Rham Jas, Shaun San Dena, and others to summon or confront the demon Lamia, involving invocation, possession, and negotiation.
entities.summary: A structured ritual gathering conducted by Rham Jas, Shaun San Dena, and others to summon or confront the demon Lamia, involving invocation, possession, and negotiation.

entities.name: room
entities.description: The enclosed interior space where the spiritual ritual takes place, characterized by sealed windows and a table.

entities.name: moments later
entities.description: A short, relative temporal marker indicating the progression of events within the ritual scene.

entities.name: Shaun San Dena
entities.description: A participant in a spiritual ritual who becomes possessed by the entity Lamia, serving as its vessel during the summoning.
entities.summary: An elderly medium with knowledge of the Lamia leads a ritual to summon the entity into a goat, resulting in possession, an exorcism attempt using a Gypsy incantation, and ultimately a fatality linked to the spirit's influence.

entities.name: Rham Jas
entities.description: A figure leading the exorcism and summoning ritual, who questions the possessing entity and attempts to negotiate with it.
entities.summary: A fifty-year-old Indian man, presenting as a seer, conducts fortune readings in a dimly lit room with a beaded curtain, offering spiritual guidance and interpreting supernatural threats using occult knowledge and rituals, while interacting with Stephanie regarding payments and a limited-print book.

entities.name: Milos
entities.description: An individual present during the ritual who uncovers a slaughtering blade upon Rham Jas's signal.
entities.summary: A thirty-year-old Hungarian man assists in a ritual involving Stephanie, a black goat, and a slaughtering blade, during which he is possessed by a Lamia spirit, undergoes exorcism, and pleads to stop the ritual.

entities.name: Stephanie Brown
entities.description: A person targeted by the entity Lamia, who claims her soul is intended for torment in hell.
entities.summary: A woman seeks a fortune reading with Ray from Rham Jas; a bank employee seeks forgiveness from Sylvia Ganush's family; someone is targeted by Lamia for eternal torment; another confronts Mrs. Ganush's corpse in a ritual during a storm.

entities.name: Jim Jacks
entities.description: Stephanie Brown's manager, whom she attempts to implicate as responsible for her situation during the ritual.
entities.summary:
Stephanie Brown's manager, whom she attempts to implicate as responsible for her situation during the ritual.
A man who calls Stephanie to deliver urgent news about their mutual acquaintance, Stu Rubin.

entities.name: Lamia
entities.description: A demonic entity summoned during the ritual, who speaks through the possessed body of Shaun San Dena and declares intent to claim Stephanie Brown's soul.
entities.summary: A malevolent entity called the 'Black Goat' is summoned through a curse on Stephanie, communicated via possessed individuals including Shaun San Dena and Milos, and targeted for expulsion during an exorcism.

entities.name: slaughtering blade
entities.description: A blade uncovered by Milos during the ritual, likely intended for use in confronting or repelling the summoned entity.

entities.name: Stephanie Brown places Shaun San Dena's hand on the goat's head to transfer Lamia's spirit
entities.description: Stephanie quickly takes Shaun San Dena's hand and places it on the head of a goat in an attempt to expel the possessing spirit of Lamia into the animal.

entities.name: Shaun San Dena briefly regains consciousness amid spiritual struggle
entities.description: Shaun San Dena's eyes clear momentarily as she fights to regain control of her body, indicating a battle between her will and the possessing spirit of Lamia.

entities.name: Lamia's spirit is partially transferred into the goat
entities.description: The spirit of Lamia moves from Shaun San Dena into the goat, causing the animal to bleat and buck wildly as it becomes possessed.

entities.name: Milos raises the slaughtering blade to strike the possessed goat
entities.description: In response to the goat's possession, Milos lifts the slaughtering blade with the intent to destroy the vessel containing Lamia's spirit.

entities.name: Possessed goat speaks with Lamia's voice and evades the blade
entities.description: The goat, now channeling Lamia, cries out in a demonic voice and dodges the descending blade, which instead slashes into the chair.

entities.name: Possessed goat bites Milos's hand during attack
entities.description: As Milos prepares a second strike, the possessed goat bites his hand, creating a physical conduit for the transfer of the spirit.

entities.name: Lamia's spirit transfers from goat to Milos
entities.description: Through the bite, the spirit of Lamia leaves the goat and enters Milos, immediately taking control of his body.

entities.name: Milos becomes fully possessed by Lamia and screams in supernatural rage
entities.description: After the spirit transfer, Milos lets out a terrifying scream and turns toward Stephanie with blackened, goat-like eyes, now fully under Lamia's control.

entities.name: Possessed Milos shouts in unknown tongues at Stephanie Brown
entities.description: Under Lamia's influence, Milos hurls incomprehensible, guttural speech at Stephanie, expressing supernatural fury and mockery.

entities.name: Possessed Milos levitates and dances uncontrollably on the table
entities.description: Milos's body jerks into the air and begins dancing erratically atop the table, laughing hysterically as part of the demonic manifestation.

entities.name: Rham Jas is struck by a flying chair and knocked to the ground
entities.description: While attempting to command the spirit, Rham Jas is interrupted when a chair is hurled through the air and shatters against his back, incapacitating him.

entities.name: Milos's body is thrown against the chandelier and glass rains down
entities.description: The possessed Milos is flung upward into the chandelier, shattering it and causing glass to fall onto Stephanie below.

entities.name: Milos spins on the ceiling like a pinwheel in supernatural display
entities.description: After crashing into the chandelier, Milos's body is spun violently around the ceiling as if controlled by an invisible force, demonstrating Lamia's power.

entities.name: Stephanie Brown attempts to flee but is blocked by a moving bureau
entities.description: Fleeing in terror, Stephanie rushes toward the door only to have her escape path blocked by a large bureau that suddenly shifts into place.

entities.name: Rham Jas rouses Shaun San Dena to banish the possessing spirit
entities.description: After recovering from being struck, Rham Jas helps Shaun San Dena regain awareness and urges her to take action to expel the spirit of Lamia.

entities.description: A sacrificial animal used in the ritual, temporarily possessed by the spirit of Lamia before transferring to Milos.

entities.description: A piece of furniture that is hurled through the air and strikes Rham Jas, knocking him down.

document_metadata.summary: Shaun San Dena collapses after exorcising the Lamia; despite CPR, she dies. Rham Jas pronounces her gone, reciting a prayer as Milos calls for an ambulance.

entities.description: During the physical struggle, Mrs. Ganush grabs Stephanie's head and violently tears out a portion of her hair as part of the supernatural assault.

entities.description: In a grotesque supernatural act, Mrs. Ganush regurgitates the corpse of Stephanie's deceased cat, producing it from her mouth and depositing it on the table as a psychological and spiritual attack.

entities.description: Overwhelmed by horror at seeing her dead cat vomited onto the table, Stephanie breaks down into hysterical screaming.
